title: Digital Consumer Experience (CX) Designer, R&D
description:
**About the Team**

We are an innovative global healthcare company driven by one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. With a presence in more than 100 countries, our teams are dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine and turning the impossible into the possible.

Sanofi is on an ambitious digital transformation journey, accelerating data-driven innovation and the adoption of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning across R&D, manufacturing, and commercial operations.

As a CX Designer within Digital R&D, you will help shape intuitive, effective digital experiences that support this transformation. You will work as part of a global Consumer Experience (CX) team and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and business stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization.

**About You**

* You are a product designer who combines strong interaction and visual design skills with sound product judgment.
* You are comfortable working in an environment where requirements may not always arrive fully defined. You know how to ask the right questions, identify what information is missing, create structure from ambiguity, and move work forward without waiting for every detail to be provided.
* You bring a design point of view to the table rather than simply executing requirements. You can translate business and user needs into clear experience recommendations, communicate the rationale behind your decisions, and work constructively with Product and Engineering to refine solutions.
* You are organized, proactive, and reliable. You communicate clearly, manage priorities effectively, follow through on commitments, and raise risks or changes early.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own product design work from problem definition through detailed design and development handoff.
* Partner with Product to understand the business problem, user needs, constraints, and desired outcomes, then develop and recommend appropriate experience solutions.
* Conduct lightweight research, competitive review, benchmarking, and design exploration as needed to inform decisions.
* Create clear information architecture, user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that show how the overall experience fits together.
* Balance product-level thinking with attention to interaction, visual design, content, edge cases, and error states.
* Work iteratively with Product and Engineering, sharing work early, incorporating feedback, and refining solutions rather than waiting for perfect inputs.
* Clearly communicate design recommendations, decisions, Progress, risks, and next steps in meetings and written documentation.
* Prioritize effectively across competing requests and stay focused on agreed product and delivery priorities.
* Maintain design documentation and specifications that are clear enough for Product, Engineering, and other designers to use.
* Participate actively in Agile ways of working, including planning, reviews, demos, and cross-functional discussions.
* Apply and contribute to Sanofi design systems, standards, and the One Sanofi Experience.
* Use AI-enabled design and prototyping tools thoughtfully to accelerate exploration and execution while applying independent design judgment to the final outcome.
* Build productive working relationships across global and local teams and contribute to a collaborative design culture.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Design, HCI, or related field.
* 3+ years of product, UX, or interaction design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating your design process and shipped digital products.
* Strong product design fundamentals, including interaction design, information architecture, user flows, prototyping, and visual design.
* Demonstrated ability to work through complex or ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, actionable design solutions.
* Ability to work independently while knowing when to seek input, alignment, or support.
* Experience partnering directly with Product Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain design decisions clearly and concisely.
* Strong prioritization, organization, and follow-through across multiple workstreams.
* Experience with iterative design and Agile product development.
* Proficiency with Figma and collaborative design tools such as FigJam or Miro.
* Experience working with design systems and responsive digital products.
* Familiarity with rapid prototyping and AI-enabled design tools.
* Working knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is helpful.
* Experience in healthcare, life sciences, enterprise products, or other complex domains is a plus.

**What will help you succeed**  
Success in this role requires more than strong design craft. You should be able to create clarity from ambiguity, exercise sound judgment, communicate proactively, manage commitments reliably, and build trust with the people you work with.

You will be expected to bring recommendations rather than only identify problems, maintain focus on agreed priorities, and help move the product forward through thoughtful, collaborative design.

Why choose us?

  

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
* Opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating with diverse business teams and vendors, working in a dynamic team, and fully empowered to propose and implement innovative ideas.

**Pursue** *Progress*. **Discover** *Extraordinary*.

Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let’s pursue progress. And let’s discover Extraordinary together.

At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!

title: Sr UX Designer
description:
**About Clean Harbors:**

Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by **Mr. Alan S. McKim**.

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 25,000 employees and has over 750 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to create user-friendly, scalable, and accessible designs for enterprise applications and SaaS platforms. The candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end design process, from understanding user and business needs to creating wireframes, prototypes, and final designs. The ideal candidate should have strong UX skills, advanced Figma knowledge, and experience with AI-powered design tools. They should be able to solve problems creatively, collaborate with product and engineering teams, and balance user needs with business and technical requirements. Experience in designing and launching products is preferred.

Must-Have Skills

* 7+ years of hands-on UI/UX or Product Design experience, preferably designing complex enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, and responsive web/mobile experiences.
* Advanced Figma expertise, including Auto Layout, components, variables, interactive prototyping, and creating and maintaining scalable design systems.
* Strong UX problem-solving skills, including user research, persona-based workflows, information architecture, journey mapping, usability testing, and interaction design.
* Practical experience with AI-assisted design workflows, using Figma Make, Figma AI, Google Stitch, ChatGPT, or equivalent tools for research synthesis, ideation, rapid prototyping, and design exploration.
* Understanding of AI-assisted design-to-code workflows, including Figma Dev Mode, MCP integrations, Cursor, or similar tools for improving design-to-development efficiency.
* Strong visual design capabilities, including typography, color, layout, responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), Google Material Design, and Apple Human Interface Guidelines.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to independently collaborate with Product Owners, business users, developers, and cross-functional Agile teams.

title: n8n Automation Specialist & Web Designer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled n8n Automation Specialist & Web Designer who can build professional websites, create end-to-end automations, integrate third-party applications, and use AI tools to deliver projects efficiently.

The primary focus is n8n, Zapier, no-code website development, end-to-end integrations, and AI-assisted coding. The ideal candidate should be able to manage projects from website creation and automation setup to integration, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Website Design & Development

* Build, design, and maintain responsive websites using WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Framer, and Webflow.
* Create professional business websites, landing pages, forms, and e-commerce experiences with strong UI/UX.
* Use AI tools to build, customize, and improve websites efficiently.
* Work with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to add custom functionality and troubleshoot issues.
* Manage website content, plugins, themes, basic SEO, performance, hosting, domains, and SSL.

2. n8n & Zapier Automation

* Build, manage, and optimize multi-step workflows using n8n and Zapier.
* Automate lead generation, lead management, notifications, email/SMS follow-ups, reporting, and repetitive business processes.
* Connect websites, CRMs, Google Sheets, databases, marketing platforms, and other applications.
* Work with APIs, webhooks, triggers, conditional logic, JSON, and data transformations.
* Build AI-powered workflows and agents using LLM APIs.
* Implement error handling, troubleshoot workflow failures, and ensure reliable automation.

3. End-to-End Integrations

* Connect websites with CRMs, e-commerce platforms, payment gateways, email marketing tools, and other third-party applications.
* Build complete workflows from website form submissions to CRM updates, lead assignments, notifications, and follow-ups.
* Integrate WordPress, Shopify, and WooCommerce with automation platforms and external services.
* Configure API authentication, webhooks, and data synchronization between different systems.
* Test complete workflows to ensure data flows correctly between all connected applications.
* Troubleshoot integration issues and maintain reliable connections.

4. AI-Powered Development & Technical Support

* Use ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other AI tools for website development, coding, debugging, and automation.
* Build AI agents and assistants for lead qualification, customer support, data processing, and business operations.
* Integrate LLM APIs into n8n workflows, websites, and business applications.
* Use AI to generate and customize HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when no-code tools cannot meet requirements.
* Troubleshoot website, hosting, domain, API, and integration issues.
* Document workflows and maintain websites and automation systems.

n8n Automation Specialist & Web Designer

Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience: Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience in website development, automation, or related technical roles.

* n8n & Zapier: Strong hands-on experience building and managing end-to-end automation workflows.
* Website Development: Practical experience with WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Framer, and Webflow.
* End-to-End Integrations: Ability to connect websites, CRMs, e-commerce platforms, payment gateways, and third-party applications.
* APIs & Webhooks: Understanding of API authentication, JSON, data mapping, webhooks, and troubleshooting.
* AI & LLM Integrations: Experience building AI agents and integrating LLM APIs into automation workflows.
* HTML, CSS & JavaScript: Ability to build, customize, and troubleshoot website functionality using AI-assisted coding.
* CRM & Marketing Automation: Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL), HubSpot, and related marketing platforms.
* E-commerce Integrations: Experience connecting Shopify or WooCommerce with CRMs, payment systems, and external applications.
* Problem-Solving: Ability to independently identify issues and implement effective technical solutions.

Who We're Looking For

* A self-driven professional who can manage projects from start to finish.
* Someone who can independently build websites and connect all required systems.
* An automation-focused problem solver who enjoys eliminating repetitive tasks.
* Comfortable using AI and no-code tools to improve productivity.
* Able to test, troubleshoot, and maintain websites, integrations, and workflows independently.
* A fast learner who can adapt to new tools and technologies.

Expected Outcomes

* Professional, responsive websites delivered from start to finish.
* Reliable n8n and Zapier workflows that reduce manual work.
* Seamless integrations between websites, CRMs, and business applications.
* AI-powered solutions that improve business efficiency.
* Fully tested, documented, and maintainable websites and automation systems.

* Provident Fund

* Custom Shopify: 3 years (Preferred)
* WordPress: 3 years (Preferred)

title: Interior Designer
description:
An Interior Designer is responsible for planning, designing, and creating functional, attractive, and comfortable interior spaces for residential, commercial, and other projects. The role involves understanding client requirements, preparing design concepts and layouts, selecting materials and finishes, coordinating with vendors and contractors, and ensuring that projects are completed within the approved budget and timeline.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand client requirements, preferences, budget, and project objectives.
* Prepare interior design concepts, mood boards, space plans, and furniture layouts.
* Develop 2D drawings and 3D visualizations using software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, and 3ds Max.
* Select suitable materials, colors, lighting, furniture, fixtures, and finishes.
* Prepare working drawings, detailed drawings, and design specifications.
* Coordinate with architects, civil engineers, electrical engineers, carpenters, contractors, and vendors.
* Conduct site visits to monitor project progress and ensure design accuracy.
* Ensure efficient space utilization, functionality, aesthetics, and safety standards.
* Estimate project costs, prepare material lists, and assist with budget management.
* Monitor quality of workmanship and resolve design-related site issues.
* Track project schedules and ensure timely completion.
* Present design proposals to clients and incorporate feedback.
* Stay updated on interior design trends, materials, technologies, and industry standards.

Required Skills

* Creativity and strong design sense.
* Knowledge of space planning and interior design principles.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, or similar design software.
* Understanding of materials, furniture, lighting, and finishes.
* Knowledge of technical drawings and construction details.
* Communication, presentation, and client-handling skills.
* Vendor coordination and negotiation skills.
* Time management, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects.

Educational Qualifications

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or a related field.
* Relevant project experience or a portfolio of interior design work is preferred.
* Knowledge of site execution and project coordination is an advantage.

Experience

* Fresher: Basic design knowledge, software skills, creativity, and willingness to learn.
* 1–3 years: Design development, client coordination, working drawings, and site supervision.
* 3+ years: Independent project handling, budget management, vendor coordination, and team supervision.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of projects.
* Client satisfaction and design approval.
* Quality of drawings and execution.
* Budget adherence and material optimization.
* Effective coordination with vendors and site teams.
* Compliance with project specifications and safety standards.

Pay: Up to ₹50,000.00 per month

title: Graphic and video Designer
description:
**About Zithara.ai**

At **Zithara.ai**, we are pioneering the next generation of **Customer Intelligence**. Our platform serves as the "North Star" for consumer brands, empowering them to unify disparate customer data, automate personalized omnichannel engagement, and deploy advanced AI Agents for sales, support, and marketing. Zithara.ai simplifies retention and accelerates revenue growth for high-transaction, data-rich industries across India and Australia.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a talented **Graphic & Video Editor** to own the visual identity of Zithara.ai. Unlike traditional consumer design roles, this position requires a unique blend of technical understanding and aesthetic precision. You will be responsible for creating high-fidelity assets that simplify complex B2B workflows, demonstrate software ROI, and maintain a premium, trustworthy brand image across all digital touchpoints.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Video Production & Editing (Primary Focus)**

* **Product Demos:** Edit high-impact software demo videos; this includes screen recording, motion tracking, and adding annotations that guide the viewer through complex UI/UX without overwhelming them.
* **Explainer Videos:** Create short-form (30-90 sec) animated explainer videos that break down how Zithara.ai solves specific enterprise pain points.
* **Social & Ads:** Edit vertical (9:16) and horizontal (16:9) video content for LinkedIn, YouTube, and paid ad campaigns, optimized for engagement and conversion.
* **Webinars & Case Studies:** Edit long-form content (webinars, customer interviews) into digestible highlight reels and testimonial snippets.

**2. Graphic Design**

* **Visual Assets:** Design compelling marketing collateral including eBooks, whitepapers, one-pagers, and pitch decks that align with our B2B brand guidelines.
* **Digital Ads:** Create static and animated display ads (HTML5/MP4) for retargeting campaigns and LinkedIn Ads.
* **Brand Consistency:** Maintain a cohesive visual language across the website, social media, and sales enablement materials, ensuring all designs look "enterprise-ready."

**3. Collaboration & Strategy**

* Work closely with the Product Marketing team to understand technical features and translate them into user-centric visual narratives.
* Manage the post-production workflow, ensuring assets are delivered on time for product launches and marketing campaigns.
* Stay ahead of design trends within the B2B SaaS space, specifically regarding motion design and UI/UX communication.

**Required Qualification:**

* **Experience:** 1-2 years of experience in graphic design and video editing, preferably within B2B, SaaS, Tech, or Martech industries.
* **Portfolio:** A strong portfolio demonstrating:

  + Clean, minimalistic design aesthetics.
  + Software/product demo editing (UI recording).
  + Motion graphics that explain technical concepts.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Ability to understand software dashboards, APIs, and workflows enough to visually represent them accurately.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Clarity:** Complex SaaS features are understood by prospects within the first 10 seconds of viewing your video.
* **Engagement:** Increased video retention rates on LinkedIn and YouTube.
* **Conversion:** Visual assets contribute to a higher click-through rate (CTR) on ad campaigns and improved demo request rates.

**Why Join Zithara.ai?**

* Work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI technology and creative storytelling.
* Opportunity to build a visual brand from a foundational level to a market-leading presence.
* Competitive salary, equity options, and [list benefits: health insurance, flexible hours, etc.].
* Direct impact on revenue—your designs will be seen by top enterprise executive

title: Senior UX Designer, Design
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Business stands at the intersection of tech & retail in the B2B space developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. The Amazon Business User Experience team champions the business customer in the Amazon Marketplace and supports procurement elements for Amazon Business customers. Areas that a Senior UX Designer in AB team will support include partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver costumer-centric solutions for admins involved in business procurement for all sizes of businesses. You will work with the foundational services team to enhance the account management tools in the account configuration and analytics space.
  
  
A Senior UX Designer in this organization works on the tactical and strategic. They determine the strategy and where to simplify or extend solutions for the best outcome. They will drive the use of best practices and learn to influence and force multiply. This role needs to be capable of operating autonomously in partnering with product stakeholders from the enterprise account management team to research, define requirements and realize solutions for complex problems across the end-to-end account admins experience. This role will be instrumental in defining the agentic experiences leveraging latest AI technologies.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Senior UX Designer's role is to facilitate process where there is ambiguity in product strategy, product requirements, and technical feasibility. They will be expected to pull insights, guide product stakeholders into design exercises and activities to shape and prioritize user stories ahead of designing solutions. This role must be able to recognize risks and effectively communicate and escalate issues that may impact the customer experience, then help to arrive at solutions that are acceptable to cross-functional stakeholders - be it peers or skip-level. This role is a key contributor to generating design documents that succinctly communicate recommendations, limitations, trade-offs and product direction to leaders across the org. This role must be able to articulate potential consequences of short-term solutions that may negatively impact customers. Where there are opportunities, a Senior UX Designer must propose optimal long-term solutions as methods of inventing and simplifying for the greatest impact in delivery. This role will be instrumental in helping to inform and shape product roadmaps, business goals, objectives and metrics that all add customer value.  
  
A day in the life  
The Senior UX Designer is a vocal advocate for the customer, and they will work on multiple initiatives concurrently. This role operates as an ambassador for best practices, impactful trends, and continually innovates on released features. This role will be a highly visible team player through their ability to pull stakeholders together to collaborate. As a Sr. UX designer and champion of people, their mentoring will include critiquing, providing design feedback, conducting retros & research that can influence engineering team decisions to enable optimal solutions for our customers.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of UX designer or interaction designer experience
* Have an online portfolio or samples of work on resume, demonstrating experience creating great end-to-end, user-centered design solutions and patterns, across desktop and mobile devices
* Experience in delivering design solutions for projects of large scope and complexity
* Experience working with stakeholders to plan and execute programs that are strategic in nature
* Experience using customer insights and data to deeply understand target customers and dive deep
* Experience in a variety of design, wire-framing, and prototyping tools

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience applying scrum to visual or UX design processes
* Master's degree or equivalent in design, human-computer interaction (HCI), or Master's degree
* Experience in B2B, high-tech products/services preferred
* Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale

title: Interior Designer
description:
About the Role

Benaka Healthcare is looking for a **detail\-oriented Interior Designer** to support our **turnkey hospital and healthcare infrastructure projects**. You will be responsible for developing interior design concepts, detailed drawings, and specifications that translate clinical requirements into functional, safe, and aesthetically pleasing healthcare environments.

You will play a critical role in shaping **patient areas, clinical spaces, and staff environments**, ensuring designs are practical, compliant with healthcare standards, and seamlessly executed on site for hospitals, diagnostic centres, and modular OT projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop **interior design layouts and detailed drawings** for hospital spaces including OPDs, patient rooms, ICUs, waiting areas, nursing stations, diagnostics, and administrative areas.
* Prepare **interior working drawings** such as furniture layouts, ceiling plans, lighting layouts, flooring patterns, wall finishes, and joinery details.
* Coordinate interior designs with **architectural and MEP layouts** to ensure clash\-free execution.
* Assist in designing interiors for **modular OTs, recovery rooms, and sterile zones** as per hospital norms.
* Select and specify **materials, finishes, colours, and fixtures** suitable for healthcare environments (durability, hygiene, safety).
* Revise drawings and designs based on **site conditions, client feedback, and project updates**.
* Work closely with architects, engineers, vendors, and the execution team to ensure designs are **buildable and executed as intended**.
* Ensure interior designs comply with **healthcare standards and guidelines** (NABH, NBC, fire safety, infection control norms).
* Support **BOQ preparation**, vendor coordination, and material finalisation where required.
* Maintain proper **drawing documentation, version control, and approvals** throughout the project lifecycle.

Requirements

* Diploma or Degree in **Interior Design / Architecture**.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD (2D mandatory)**; knowledge of SketchUp, 3D tools, or rendering software is an advantage.
* Prior experience in **hospital, healthcare, or commercial interior projects** preferred.
* Understanding of **healthcare interior planning**, material selection, and hygiene\-focused design.
* Basic knowledge of **MEP coordination and on\-site execution processes**.
* Ability to read architectural, structural, and services drawings.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and time management.
* Good communication skills to coordinate with internal teams, consultants, and vendors.

Why Join Benaka Projects?

* Work on **meaningful healthcare projects** that directly impact patient care and outcomes.
* Exposure to **end\-to\-end turnkey execution** of hospitals and diagnostic facilities.
* Opportunity to grow with a company shaping **modern healthcare spaces across India**.
* Collaborative environment with hands\-on learning and real\-world project responsibility.
